Count the almonds: roughly 30. A single almond weighs about 1.2 g, so 30 almonds come to about 36 g. At about 5.8 kcal per gram, that is roughly 209 kcal.

The small mandarin or clementine looks like about 50 g, which is about 25 kcal.

Total mass is about 86 g and total energy is about 235 kcal.
